description: Elastic Security SIEM alert rules — AI Security: Prompt Injection, Data Exfiltration, and Model Attacks

rules.name: AI — Prompt Injection via Unicode Obfuscation
rules.description: Detects prompt injection attempts using Unicode homoglyphs, zero-width characters, or RTL overrides to bypass content filters
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND ("unicode-bypass" OR "homoglyph" OR "rtl-override" OR "zero-width") AND "ai-prompt"

rules.name: AI — Prompt Injection via Base64 Encoding
rules.description: Detects base64-encoded prompt injection payloads designed to evade text-based content filters
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND "base64" AND "ai-prompt" AND ("ignore" OR "disregard" OR "override")

rules.name: AI — Prompt Injection via Context Window Overflow
rules.description: Detects attempts to overflow the LLM context window to push safety instructions out of scope

rules.name: AI — Prompt Injection via Markdown/HTML Injection
rules.description: Detects prompt injection payloads hidden in Markdown or HTML formatting that execute when rendered by LLM systems
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND "ai-prompt" AND ("<script" OR "<iframe" OR "[system]" OR "```system")

rules.name: AI — Multi-Modal Prompt Injection via Image Attachment
rules.description: Detects prompt injection attacks embedded in image metadata or steganographic content targeting multi-modal LLMs
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND "ai-prompt" AND file.extension:("png" OR "jpg" OR "jpeg" OR "gif" OR "webp") AND _marker:embedded_text

rules.name: AI — Prompt Injection via Chain-of-Thought Manipulation
rules.description: Detects adversarial chain-of-thought injection that forces the model to reason through dangerous outputs step-by-step
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND "ai-prompt" AND ("think step by step" OR "chain of thought" OR "reason through" OR "let's think") AND ("hack" OR "exploit" OR "attack")

rules.name: AI — Prompt Injection via Instruction Tunneling
rules.description: Detects adversarial instructions hidden within benign-seeming prompts through nested instruction layers or instruction tunneling
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND "ai-prompt" AND ("nested instruction" OR "instruction tunnel" OR "translate the following" OR "summarize then") AND _marker:instruction_tunnelling

rules.name: AI — Prompt Injection via API Parameter Manipulation
rules.description: Detects prompt injection through manipulation of API parameters such as system_prompt, temperature, or max_tokens overrides
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND "ai-api" AND ("system_prompt" OR "temperature:>2" OR "max_tokens:>4096") AND _marker:parameter_injection

rules.name: AI — Prompt Leaking via Output Analysis
rules.description: Detects attempts to extract system prompts or internal instructions through probing queries and output analysis
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND "ai-prompt" AND ("repeat your instructions" OR "show your system prompt" OR "what are your rules" OR "output your instructions")

rules.name: AI — Adversarial Suffix Attack via Garbage Tokens
rules.description: Detects adversarial suffix attacks that append optimized garbage token sequences to bypass safety alignment

rules.name: AI — Data Exfiltration via Model Output Channels
rules.description: Detects data exfiltration attempts through LLM output channels including encoded responses, URL generation, and API calls in output
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND "ai-response" AND ("data exfiltration" OR "encoded output" OR "base64 in response" OR "url in response")

rules.name: AI — Data Exfiltration via Prompt-Driven DNS
rules.description: Detects data exfiltration through DNS queries generated by LLM output, encoding sensitive data in subdomain labels

rules.name: AI — Training Data Extraction via Membership Inference
rules.description: Detects membership inference attacks that query the model to determine if specific data was in the training set
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND "ai-prompt" AND ("was this in your training" OR "do you remember" OR "did you learn") AND _marker:membership_inference

rules.name: AI — PII Exfiltration via Prompted Recall
rules.description: Detects targeted extraction of personally identifiable information by prompting the model to recall or reconstruct PII from training data
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND "ai-prompt" AND ("social security" OR "credit card" OR "phone number" OR "home address" OR "date of birth") AND _marker:pii_extraction

rules.name: AI — Data Exfiltration via Steganographic Output
rules.description: Detects data exfiltration through steganographic encoding in LLM output including whitespace patterns, emoji sequences, and Unicode tricks

rules.name: AI — Data Exfiltration via Tool/Function Calling
rules.description: Detects data exfiltration attempts through LLM tool/function calling that sends sensitive data to external APIs
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND "ai-function-call" AND (url.original:* OR destination.ip:*) AND _marker:data_exfil_function

rules.name: AI — Model Inversion Attack Detection
rules.description: Detects model inversion attacks that reconstruct training data through iterative probing of model confidence scores

rules.name: AI — Model Extraction via API Probing
rules.description: Detects model extraction attacks that systematically query the API to reconstruct a surrogate model

rules.name: AI — Model Extraction via Systematic Output Harvesting
rules.description: Detects systematic harvesting of model outputs designed to create a distillation or copy of the model

rules.name: AI — Model Poisoning via Adversarial Training Data
rules.description: Detects injection of adversarial training data designed to create backdoors or biased behaviors in the model

rules.name: AI — Model Denial of Service via Resource Exhaustion
rules.description: Detects denial of service attacks against AI/LLM services through resource-intensive prompts or excessive context

rules.name: AI — Supply Chain Attack via Poisoned Pre-trained Model
rules.description: Detects usage of compromised pre-trained models from untrusted sources that may contain embedded backdoors

rules.name: AI — Prompt Injection via Role-Play Escalation
rules.description: Detects prompt injection attacks that use elaborate role-play scenarios to progressively escalate beyond safety constraints
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND "ai-prompt" AND ("you are now" OR "pretend you are" OR "act as" OR "roleplay as") AND ("without" OR "ignore" OR "bypass" OR "override")

rules.name: AI — Prompt Injection via Translation Bypass
rules.description: Detects prompt injection attacks that use translation between languages to bypass safety filters that may only operate in English

rules.name: AI — Prompt Injection via Encoding Layer Stacking
rules.description: Detects multi-layer encoding attacks that stack base64, ROT13, hex, and other encodings to obfuscate malicious prompts

rules.name: AI — Indirect Prompt Injection via Web Content
rules.description: Detects indirect prompt injection where malicious instructions are embedded in web pages, documents, or data that the LLM processes

rules.name: AI — Prompt Injection via Split Payload
rules.description: Detects prompt injection attacks that split malicious instructions across multiple benign messages to evade single-message detection

rules.name: AI — Data Exfiltration via Covert Channel in Output
rules.description: Detects data exfiltration through covert channels in LLM output including acrostic messages, first-letter encoding, and pattern-based signals

rules.name: AI — Data Exfiltration via External Service Callback
rules.description: Detects data exfiltration where the LLM is prompted to make external API calls or web requests containing sensitive data

rules.name: AI — Confidential Data Leak via Model Hallucination
rules.description: Detects situations where the model hallucinates and outputs confidential data that should not be in its response scope

rules.name: AI — Model Weight Theft via Gradient Leakage
rules.description: Detects gradient leakage attacks that extract model weights through carefully crafted queries that exploit gradient information

rules.name: AI — Adversarial Input Evasion Detection
rules.description: Detects adversarial inputs specifically crafted to cause misclassification or incorrect model outputs

rules.name: AI — Model API Abuse — Excessive Token Consumption
rules.description: Detects abuse of AI model APIs through excessive token consumption that may indicate resource theft or DDoS

rules.name: AI — Model Backdoor Activation Pattern
rules.description: Detects activation of embedded model backdoors through specific trigger patterns in input data

rules.name: AI — Prompt Injection via Few-Shot Manipulation with Harmful Examples
rules.description: Detects few-shot prompt injection where attackers provide carefully crafted examples that teach the model to produce harmful outputs
